editionLabel: Indie Boards & Cards official Dized rules
firstPlayerRule: Randomly select a player and give them the leader token; they are the leader at the start of the game.
clarifications: At the end of each round, the leader token passes clockwise to the next player.
With the Lady of the Lake variant, the Lady of the Lake token starts with the player on the leader's right.

internalEvidence: Saved and read the Dized rules page for Setup step 2: 'Randomly select a player and give that player the leader token. This player will be the leader at the start of the game.' The End of round page (rules.dized.com/game/rZluqS52QmGdpoVxcmVLtg/N1CwFhVhT62DAmDo-ukZTw/end-of-round), step 4: 'Pass the leader token clockwise to the next player and begin a new round.' The Dized landing page lists publisher Indie Game Studios and states 'These official rules are maintained and verified by the game publisher(s)'; 5-10 players with Merlin, Assassin and Lady of the Lake matches BGG 128882.
